The UI starter has two Clips and a Crossfade; removing all Clips and the empty Layer through MCP leaves a durable empty composition at Show End 1000 ms with its Layout interval covering exactly 1000 ms.

Reload, Show-file reopen, EPE reopen, and fixed-time Stage captures agree with the saved authored Show.
partitions: Incremental authoring from a deliberately emptied UI starter versus complete uploaded composition into a separate new Show.
Empty save, private uncommitted additions, authored save, and reloaded save.
Single-Zone adjacent red/green Clips versus two-Zone left/right swap.
250 ms and 750 ms on opposite sides of the 500 ms cut; deliberately incorrect image samples versus restored correct samples.

sequences: Seed only synthetic Patterns, create a named Portable Show in Studio, read the generated UUID and stored starter, then reopen its route with capture enabled.

Bind real MCP, read starter IDs, begin, remove_clips, remove_layer, set_show_end, commit and read saved outcome; begin again, create_layers with a red Clip, create_clips with a green Clip, check unchanged durable preimage, commit and read saved outcome.
Bind real MCP to a different UI-created Show, read, begin, replace_show with a complete two-Zone candidate, commit and read saved outcome.
Capture before and after reload, download both Show actions, parse the downloaded files, and record an ignored run manifest.
oracles: Full D1 ShowRecordV2 equality against an expected record built from the UI-created preimage and only returned opaque IDs; exact empty composition, Layout duration, and no starter remnants.
Visible personal rail selection, absence from Built-in Shows, visible authored Clip buttons, and literal opaque RGBA at declared 32x32 grid centres in real canvas PNGs.
The wrong fixed-time image expectation throws before the matching expected samples pass.

The downloaded .pxlshow is reopened through parseShowFileBundle with acceptV2 and equals the saved record; the downloaded .epe passes parseEpe, Show stamp/output contract, artifactHash, render export, and filename suffix checks.
Each manifest records zero browser errors, safe MCP calls, saved outcomes, UUID and UI creation path, PNG and download hashes/byte counts, reopen results, and focused timing.
residualGaps: Fast 2D plane preview with full primary colours does not qualify Precise rendering, hardware, or arbitrary Pattern dependencies.
These finite examples do not qualify every MCP command or all possible new-Show output contracts.
The EPE parser and source stamp check integrity and provenance of the downloaded output; it does not execute that file on a Controller.
